Geometry helpers, hull/wheelhouse/deck builders, fish anatomy and geometry, rod geometry/state transitions, and the line-tension fight are reused. Engine imports are translated to Three.js. GameMaterials.js is a WebGL material adapter; the original WGSL renderer is not included. FishTable.js redirects the minigame to Pacific Drift's regional gameplay catalogue.
